_readme: Every price, package, question and contact detail on the site lives in this file.
Edit it, then run:  node build.js
Anything that is empty or starts with TODO counts as blank, and the matching button or section is hidden on the site.
Prices are plain numbers in rand: 1500 shows as R1 500.
Words in {curly brackets} are filled in for you, e.g. {buyout} becomes R3 500. The full list is in README.md.

card.text: Take bookings direct and keep the commission booking sites charge.

seo.title: Guesthouse Website Design South Africa | Front Door Sites
seo.description: Websites for South African guesthouses and B&Bs that bring in direct bookings, so you keep the 15–18% commission booking sites charge. From {fromPrice}.

hero.h1: A guesthouse website that brings in direct bookings
hero.lead: Booking sites take roughly 15–18% commission on every booking. When guests book through your own website, that money stays with you.

argument.heading: Every direct booking keeps the commission in your pocket
paragraphs: Booking sites are good at sending you new guests. But they take a cut of every booking: roughly 15–18%, depending on the site and the extras you pay for.

Lots of guests find you on a booking site, then look you up on Google before they book. Returning guests and referrals do the same. If they find your own website with your rooms, rates and a 'Book direct' button, many will book there instead.
You don't have to leave the booking sites. Keep them for new guests, and let your website catch everyone who's already looking for you.
points: Rooms, rates and photos that make guests want to stay
Guests book direct, or send a WhatsApp enquiry in one tap
Live availability from NightsBridge or your booking system (Direct Bookings plan)
Your Google Business Profile set up properly, so you show up on Maps

calculator.intro: Put in your own numbers. The figures below are only an example.

faq.q: Does it work with NightsBridge?
faq.a: Yes. On the Direct Bookings plan I connect your NightsBridge booking button and live availability to your site, so guests can check dates and book without leaving it. If you use a different booking system, tell me which one. Most have a booking link or widget I can connect.

faq.q: Do I have to stop using Booking.com or Airbnb?
faq.a: No. Keep your listings for new guests. Your website gives returning guests, referrals and Google searchers a direct way to book, without the commission.

faq.q: I don't have a booking system. Can I still take bookings?
faq.a: Yes. On the Starter plan, guests send an enquiry through your site or on WhatsApp, and you confirm the booking yourself, the way you do now.

faq.q: Can you update my rates and seasonal specials?
faq.a: Yes. Rate changes are small edits. The Direct Bookings plan adds a rates and specials page, and I update your seasonal special for you.

seo.description: Websites for South African hair salons, nail, lash and brow studios and beauty therapists. Show your prices and reviews and take bookings. From {fromPrice}.

hero.h1: A salon website that turns Google searches into bookings
hero.lead: For hair salons, nail, lash and brow studios and beauty therapists. Clients find you on Google, check your prices and reviews, then book. Your website makes that easy.

argument.heading: Be the easy choice when someone searches
paragraphs: When someone needs a new nail tech, lash artist or hairdresser, they search on Google. They look at prices, photos and reviews, then pick the place that makes it easiest to book.

If all they find is an old Facebook post or a phone number, they keep scrolling. A simple website with your price list, your best work, your reviews and a 'Book now' or WhatsApp button turns that search into a booking.
points: Your services and prices, clear and easy to update
Your reviews, shown on your site
Booking on WhatsApp in one tap, or online through Fresha, Booksy or your own tool (Bookings plan)

faq.q: Can clients book online?
faq.a: Yes. On the Bookings plan I connect the booking tool you already use, like Fresha or Booksy, so clients can choose a time straight from your site. On Starter, clients book with you on WhatsApp in one tap.

faq.q: Can I change my prices?
faq.a: Yes. Send me your new prices on WhatsApp. Price changes are small edits, so they're included every month.

faq.q: Can you show my Google reviews on the site?
faq.a: Yes. I add a selection of your real reviews to your site and refresh them when you ask. I never write or make up reviews.

faq.q: I work from home. Do you have to show my address?
faq.a: No. You choose what's shown. Many home-based studios show only their suburb and share the exact address once a booking is confirmed.

seo.title: Restaurant & Cafe Website Design South Africa | Front Door Sites
seo.description: Websites for South African restaurants and cafes with your menu and prices, hours, directions and a live open/closed sign. From {fromPrice}.

hero.h1: A restaurant website with your menu, hours and directions
hero.lead: People search “restaurants near me” and decide in seconds. They want your menu, your hours and how to get there. If they can't find them, they choose somewhere else.

argument.heading: Answer the three questions every hungry person asks
paragraphs: What's on the menu, and what does it cost? Are you open right now? How do I get there? If those answers are scattered across old Facebook posts, people give up and go somewhere that makes it easy.
Your website puts all three on one fast page, with buttons to call you, WhatsApp you or open directions in Google Maps.
points: Your full menu with prices, easy to update
A live “open now / closed” sign based on your hours
Tap to call, WhatsApp and Google Maps directions
Table requests sent straight to you (Menu + table requests plan)

faq.q: Can I change my menu prices?
faq.a: Yes. Send me the changes on WhatsApp. Menu and price updates are small edits, so they're included every month. Edits sent by {editsDeadline} go live by {editsLive}.

faq.q: Can people book a table?
faq.a: On the Menu + table requests plan, guests fill in a short form and the request comes straight to you on WhatsApp or email. You confirm it with them.

faq.q: What about public holidays and special hours?
faq.a: Send me your holiday hours and I'll update the site. That's a small edit. The open/closed sign follows whatever hours are on your site.

faq.q: Do I need a PDF menu?
faq.a: No. I build your menu as a proper web page, which loads fast on phones and which Google can read. If you'd like a PDF download as well, I can add one.

seo.title: Website FAQ: Hosting, Domains, Edits & Payments | Front Door Sites
seo.description: Answers to common questions about Front Door Sites: what's included, small edits, owning your domain, cancelling, payments and the free mock-up.

faqPage.lead: What owners usually ask before signing up. Can't find your question? Ask me on WhatsApp or email.

faq.q: What's included?
faq.a: Design, hosting, your .co.za domain, Google Business Profile setup, and small edits every month. Each package also lists the pages and buttons you get.

faq.q: What's a small edit?
faq.a: A text, price, photo or hours change. New pages or redesigns are quoted separately, from {extraWorkFrom}. Edits sent by {editsDeadline} go live by {editsLive}.

faq.q: Do I own the domain?
faq.a: Yes, it's registered in your name.

faq.q: What if I cancel?
faq.a: There's a {minimumMonths}-month minimum, then {noticeDays} days' notice. The design is licensed to you while you subscribe. When you leave, you can buy the site for {buyout}, or it's taken down. The domain stays yours.

faq.q: How do I ask for changes?
faq.a: WhatsApp or email. Send the change, a photo or a screenshot, and I'll take it from there.

faq.q: Will it work on phones?
faq.a: Yes. It's built for phones first, then checked on tablets and computers.

faq.q: How do I pay?
faq.a: The setup fee is paid upfront. After that, the monthly fee is paid by card or debit order through PayFast, a South African payment provider.

faq.q: How fast will it be live?
faq.a: Usually within {goLive} of your payment and your content (logo, photos, prices and hours) reaching me.

faq.q: Do I need to get on a call?
faq.a: No. Everything happens on WhatsApp and email, so you can reply when it suits you.

faq.q: What's the free mock-up?
faq.a: A sample of your site, built from your public info, like your Google Maps listing or Facebook page. It's free and there's no obligation.
